eligibility: Active Fire/EMS bases with selectionEligible not false.

imagery.vintage: not independently provided by the tile response
imagery.method: Independent Leaflet captures per eligible active site at zoom 19; Belleville Fire Station 5 was additionally reviewed at zoom 18 because zoom-19 imagery tiles were unavailable.

roads.assessment: Packaged local road and service centerlines were reviewed beside imagery. Spawn points are modeled projections to selected centerlines; they do not establish driveway ownership, gates or apparatus entrances.

limits: Rectangle centers, dimensions, rotations and spawn coordinates are imagery- and road-map-based estimates, not surveyed measurements.
No official parcel plans, surveyed building footprints or apparatus entrance locations were used.
Satellite imagery dates are not supplied by the tile response.
Canonical source coordinates, base IDs, statuses and selection eligibility are preserved.
